final: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country AS country, AVG(cs.wins) AS aw FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId=cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId=r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country), o AS (SELECT AVG(wins) AS ov FROM constructorStandings), g1 AS (SELECT c.country, c.aw FROM c, o WHERE c.aw > o.ov), g2 AS (SELECT AVG(aw) AS ga FROM g1) SELECT AVG(g1.aw) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(g1.aw - o.ov) AS mean_excess_overall, AVG(g1.aw - g2.ga) AS mean_excess_group FROM g1, o, g2 WHERE g1.aw > g2.ga
